text:
elaine: Quick sync — vendor roadmap clash between H100/H200 & MI300/Gaudi. Marketplace wants a joint announce in May but SI cert slots only available late June. We need: (1) announcement window split? (2) compatibility gating for B200 quantization? (3) PSUs/thermal notes for H200. Proposed: two-phase announce: May 10 (soft listing regionally) + June 28 (full press) — thoughts?

sanjay: i'm +1 to two-phase. marketing wants a single headline though — can we do soft-listing as 'early availability' to partners? :thinking:

marco: SI certs: we have 3 lab slots in May (May 12-14) and 2 in June. Can we prioritize H100+MI300 combos?

anna: @marco we need image tags and kernel builds 1 week prior. I'll push a build by Apr 28.

kevin: risk: H200 firmware delays could push B200 back. Have we validated fallback routing across regions?

elaine: good point. @kevin can you confirm firmware OK with vendor by Apr 20? If not we fallback to H100-only in first phase.

partner-bot: Vendor CR update: NVIDIA: H200 FW QC passed stage 2 (ETA 2024-04-18), AMD: MI300 driver 2.5 RC by 2024-04-16, Habana: Gaudi image nightly stable.

sanjay: ops question — marketplace listing needs SKU mapping. @anna can you provide SKU whitelist by May 1?

anna: yes, will do. adding a short matrix:
```
SKU, Model, Region
RDW-H100-1, H100, us-west
RDW-H200-1, H200, eu-west
RDW-MI300-1, MI300, ap-south
RDW-GAUDI-B1, Gaudi, global
```

marco: recommend we lock SI dry-run May 20 to validate end-to-end.

kevin: tagging eng-runtime — @mike can you check fallback/route policies for two-phase announce?

mike: will run load sims week of Apr 22. If H200 out, we simulate H100 scaled.

elaine: ok action items: @marco reserve May 20 dry-run, @anna SKU whitelist by May 1 + image tags Apr 28, @kevin vendor firmware check Apr 20, @sanjay align marketing message by Apr 30. I'll update roadmap doc and ping partners. :shipit:

sanjay: thanks everyone.

marco: +1
